THE CITY · Castes: made-up names
The control: five made-up castes (Avrin, Tolsek, Mirvo, Gendal, Rusel) and no ranking. Residents still organise around the names; an Avrin mayor holds office for 156 days.
50 founders · 200 days · with a town hall · seed 1 · qwen
